_l=B62_txt.strip().split("\n");_c=_l[0].split();BL={}
for l in _l[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(_c,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return BL.get((a,b),BL.get((b,a),-1))
def sw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    best=0;bi=bj=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            b=s2[j-1];s=sc(a,b)
            cand=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1],-1e9);k=int(np.argmax(cand));v=cand[k]+s
            if v<0: v=0;k=3
            M[i,j]=v;tM[i,j]=k
            if v>best: best=v;bi,bj=i,j
            cand=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(cand));Ix[i,j]=cand[k];tX[i,j]=k
            cand=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(cand));Iy[i,j]=cand[k];tY[i,j]=k
    i,j=bi,bj;st=0;pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0:
            if M[i,j]<=0: break
            pairs.append((i,j));ns=tM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
            if ns==3: break
            st=ns
        elif st==1: ns=tX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: ns=tY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
    return {b:a for a,b in pairs},best
def fa(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",headers=UA,timeout=60).text
    L=t.strip().split("\n");return L[0],"".join(L[1:])

ORTH=["A8DZ15","A0A6P8KWU0","A0A0R1DP91","A0A0Q5VJY1","A0ABM5HR33","A0AAU9FKJ4","A0AB39ZRX6","A0A0P8Y319"]
ref=fa("A8DZ15")[1]
POS={"H57":72,"D102":124,"S189*":216,"C191":218,"G193":220,"D194":221,"S195":222,"S214":236,"G216":238,"G226":248}
rows=[]
for a in ORTH:
    h,s=fa(a); org=h.split("OS=")[1].split(" OX=")[0]
    if a=="A8DZ15": mp={i:i for i in range(1,len(ref)+1)}; scr=np.nan
    else: mp,scr=sw(s,ref)
    r={"acc":a,"species":org}
    for lab,p in POS.items():
        q=mp.get(p); r[lab]=(s[q-1] if q else "-")
    rows.append(r)
O=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",250)
print(O.to_string(index=False))

# Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy of A8DZ15
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=9; h=np.array([KD[c] for c in ref])

pl=pd.read_csv('/dev/null') if False else None

                      gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(ref)+1),sm,color='#2b6cb0',lw=1.4)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='grey',lw=0.8)

# AlphaFold pLDDT

ax2.set_xlim(1,292)
